paraphrase: For any God candidate g and society c: if Jesus founded c in the primitive FoundedInMandate relation to g and commissioned c to teach, then g founded c as a teaching authority. Actual HoldsMandate and Jesus≠g are not hypotheses. Stated for Jesus only; no other envoy's societies are added. The envoy-inclusive calibration entails this bridge. Under direct-only calibration it is equivalent to the additional compatibility condition that each such Jesus event also satisfies direct founding; it can hold or fail, and is refuted by the stronger exclusive reading only with a nonempty event witness.
